basis: The dashboard shows May's release volume is drastically lower than all other displayed months (visibly below 10,000 m³, whereas the next lowest is ~17,000 m³). This extreme relative deviation from the other months in the reporting cycle characterizes it as a critical low-release anomaly rather than a standard case. Background filing is inappropriate because May is clearly a low-release case requiring active review.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-release anomaly review
